title: SageCare: Runtime Healing of Superfluous Storage Fetches
abstract: We propose SageCare, a runtime system that detects and eliminates superfluous storage fetches in memory-intensive applications. By monitoring memory access patterns, SageCare adaptively adjusts prefetching policies to minimize unnecessary traffic and improve overall system performance.

title: Accelerating Transformer Inference with Structured State Space Models
abstract: This paper introduces a novel architecture combining transformer attention mechanisms with structured state space models for efficient inference. Our approach reduces memory footprint by 45% while maintaining accuracy for language modeling tasks.

title: HyperCache: Dynamic Cache Hierarchy Adaptation for ML Workloads
abstract: HyperCache dynamically reconfigures multi-level cache hierarchies based on workload characteristics. Using online profiling and machine learning predictions, we achieve 3.2x speedup on diverse ML workloads compared to static cache configurations.

title: Cascade: Efficient Multi-GPU Synchronization for DNN Training
abstract: Cascade optimizes synchronization overhead in distributed DNN training by using hierarchical reduction trees and adaptive batch sizing. We demonstrate 40% improvement in multi-GPU training throughput on large-scale models.

title: NeuralDRAM: DRAM Architecture for Neural Network Acceleration
abstract: We present NeuralDRAM, a specialized DRAM architecture optimized for neural network operations. By supporting matrix multiplication directly in memory, we reduce data movement overhead and achieve 2.5x energy efficiency improvement.

title: SpecRAN: Speculative Execution with Reconfigurable Accelerators
abstract: SpecRAN combines speculative execution with reconfigurable accelerators to improve instruction-level parallelism. Our approach uses machine learning to predict branch outcomes and reconfigure FPGAs accordingly.

title: Wavelength: Optical Interconnect for High-Performance Computing
abstract: We propose Wavelength, an optical interconnect fabric for high-performance computing clusters. Using wavelength-division multiplexing, we achieve 10x higher bandwidth density compared to electrical interconnects.

title: SmartBuffer: Intelligent Data Movement in Memory Hierarchies
abstract: SmartBuffer intelligently manages data movement across memory hierarchies using predictive analytics. By anticipating data access patterns, we reduce cache misses by 35% on irregular access patterns.

title: QuantumShift: Low-Precision Arithmetic for Quantum-Classical Hybrid Systems
abstract: QuantumShift introduces low-precision arithmetic schemes for hybrid quantum-classical algorithms. Our approach maintains algorithm correctness while reducing classical overhead by 60%.

title: PowerScope: Fine-Grained Power Management for Heterogeneous Processors
abstract: PowerScope provides fine-grained power management for heterogeneous multi-core processors. Using dynamic voltage and frequency scaling coordinated with task scheduling, we reduce power consumption by 25% with minimal performance impact.
